## Summary

Describe the change, its user impact, and the evidence or requirement it
implements.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] No secrets, investigation data, reports, or backups are included.
- [ ] Persistence, provenance, and human-review invariants remain intact.
